highlights.name: Aachen Cathedral
highlights.note: Saturday mornings in the old town

highlights.name: Rur cycle path
highlights.note: Slow rides out past the fields

reflection: Not a trip, just where everyday life happens. Train rides into Aachen, bike paths along the Rur, and a cathedral I somehow never get tired of.

highlights.name: Rijksmuseum
highlights.note: A whole morning in the Gallery of Honour

highlights.name: Jordaan
highlights.note: Apple pie on a quiet side street

reflection: Three days of bikes, bridges and slow canal light. We walked far more than we planned and still left half the list for next time.

highlights.name: Sagrada Família
highlights.note: Late-afternoon light through the stained glass

highlights.name: Bunkers del Carmel
highlights.note: The whole city turning gold at sunset

reflection: A week of late dinners and early swims. The Sagrada Família was even stranger and lovelier inside than I had imagined.

highlights.name: Along the Garonne
highlights.note: Long evening walks on the quays

highlights.name: Marché des Capucins
highlights.note: Oysters and white wine on a Saturday morning

reflection: Quiet city, long walks along the Garonne. The light in November sat low and golden on the stone facades.

highlights.name: Tate Modern
highlights.note: The Turbine Hall, then the view from the top floor

highlights.name: South Bank
highlights.note: Walking the river to the Millennium Bridge at dusk

reflection: A solo trip with no real plan. I walked the river most evenings and let the city decide the rest.

highlights.name: Arthur's Seat
highlights.note: Windy summit, the whole city below

highlights.name: Royal Mile
highlights.note: Closes and courtyards off the main street

reflection: One long day carved out of the London week. Climbing Arthur's Seat with friends in the wind was worth every hour on the train.

highlights.name: Acropolis
highlights.note: Up early, before the crowds and the heat

highlights.name: Plaka
highlights.note: Evenings in the lanes under the hill

highlights.name: Philopappos Hill
highlights.note: Sunset with the Parthenon across the way

reflection: Orange blossom in the streets and warm stone underfoot. The Acropolis felt less like a monument than a hill the whole city shares.
